'''Revald''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] operating on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|recounstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

He commanded an operation to locate and salvage the [[Null Cannon]], a devastating [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] with the ability to neutralize all electronics on its target in a single shot. The salvaged parts were recovered from a crashed Republic [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], the ''[[Vehement Sword]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
